answer: Re-attestations are stored in umber and nadir lists each lapse. A farm cannot self-supply those because the attesters must be independent on the glacier graph. Standing lapses unless 4 peers re-attest it every 13 epochs, so holding a position calls for ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 1476 impostors cost 838 times the honest price and take 26 times as long to clear. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
